{{Top|leg}}
'''Barellian''' was the term used to describe any native inhabitant of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]], regardless of whether they were [[Qieg/Legends|Qieg]] or [[Human/Legends|Human]]. The [[Qieg language|Qieg's language]] utilized body language to communicate, along with verbal chirps and clicks. As a result, Barellian Humans did not express emotions through normal means, such as on their faces, but with their hands. This made Barellian Humans hard to read, but did make them excellent [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] players.<ref name="LB">{{JournalCite|1|Lan Barell (article)}}</ref>
